subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: Should OpenClaw accept the shared `MessageActionPagination`/`--cursor` contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100858 as the path for this issue, or split the remaining pagination work by provider before committing to that API shape?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining gap, but the permanent API shape crosses the shared message-action runner, CLI, docs, and multiple provider cursor models, so this is product/API direction rather than a safe automatic fix.

options.title: Review Shared Contract
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100858 as the candidate contract and keep this issue open for the remaining provider adapters after that decision.

options.title: Split By Provider First
options.body: Open narrower provider-specific follow-ups for Discord offset, Slack cursor, Matrix nextBatch, and Feishu pageToken before accepting a shared contract.

options.title: Stop At Display Fix
options.body: Close after the formatter fix and intentionally leave multi-page message iteration out of the CLI/tool surface for now.

recommendation.title: Review Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100858 as the candidate contract and keep this issue open for the remaining provider adapters after that decision.

likelyOwner.reason: This account reopened the issue after the partial fix and stated the remaining product boundary most clearly.
